fields.name: M5 Crystal (StickS3)
fields.description:
Multifunctional firmware for pentesting and everyday use.
Wi-Fi: Scanner, deauth, WPA bruteforce, handshake capture, evil twin, evil portal, web server, channel analyzer, weather, time sync.
Bluetooth: bad BLE, sniffer, air mouse, BLE keyboard, presenter, camera shutter, bluetooth scan, device info, device finder, mouse jiggler.
IR: read and save signal, send signal, TV-B-Gone
NFC: read and write UID, tag info (PN532 module)
Settings: time, rotation, font, colors, brightness, status bar, volume, startup sound, language (7 languages), screen dimming, web server FS mode, wifi SSID
Other: clock, battery, level tool, flashlight, sound level, level tool, system info.

Rate my project on github.
Contributing is welcome.
